purpose: Assistant-led supportive, transitional, affordable and shelter-housing operator expansion requested during the commercial buyer census.
safety: Inventory seed only. No outreach is staged or sent. Do not infer purchasing need from vulnerable populations. Do not expose confidential shelter addresses. Procurement/privacy/safety requirements apply and all service opportunities require qualification.
